title: Yankee Marina & Boat Yard Inc

services.name: Boat & Yacht Storage
services.desc: Yankee Marina & Boatyard offers both outside, cold storage and inside, heated boat storage. On our protected location, with 6 acres on the Royal River, allows us to store more than 200 vessels each season. This includes storage space for large yachts and sailboats to personal watercraft. Boat hauling is done through our travel lift that permits us to haul boats up to 60 tons. Winter boat storage at Yankee Marina also gives you the opportunity to take advantage of our service crew to get your boat ready for the upcoming season. From paint and varnish to mechanical and electrical systems, Yankee Marina’s expert staff works year round to ensure your boat is ready to be launched in the spring.
